# FOWL AI

> FOWL AI is a weekly newsletter and career-intelligence site that helps knowledge workers navigate and profit from the AI economy — AI jobs, vetted AI training/evaluation platforms, and plain-English explainers on AI tools and terminology.

FOWL AI publishes a new issue every Monday covering AI jobs, training platforms, startup opportunities, and career signals for the AI economy. Content is first-hand and numbers-driven (real pay, real contracts, real screenshots) rather than theoretical. All issues stay public and are free to read without a subscription.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.fowl-ai.com/): Overview of FOWL AI and the latest issue.
- [All Issues](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/): Full archive of every weekly issue, newest first.
- [AI Jobs Board](https://www.fowl-ai.com/jobs/): Curated AI evaluation gigs and emerging career opportunities, updated weekly.
- [AI Platforms Directory](https://www.fowl-ai.com/platforms/): Vetted AI training and evaluation platforms, ranked by accessibility.
- [AI Glossary](https://www.fowl-ai.com/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of LLM, Agent, MCP, Skills, and Claude CLI, each with a real-world example.
- [AI & Future of Work FAQ](https://www.fowl-ai.com/faq/): Straight answers on job risk, real pay, required skills, and whether AI training/evaluation gigs are 1099 or W2 employment in the United States.
- [FOWL AI Tests](https://www.fowl-ai.com/tests/): Monthly head-to-head AI tool comparisons using real downloaded output files, not just chat transcripts. No sponsorships.
- [Products & Guides](https://www.fowl-ai.com/products/): Guides and templates for building AI-era income.
- [About](https://www.fowl-ai.com/about/): Who writes FOWL AI and why it exists.
- [LaunchLab: Brand Brain](https://www.fowl-ai.com/launchlab/): A guided AI workspace ("AI Building Partner") that teaches you how to turn an idea into a website, newsletter, AI avatar, and digital products you own. $99 Founding Edition. A separate business powered by FOWL AI. See also: [Own Your AI Brand](https://www.fowl-ai.com/launchlab/own-your-ai-brand/) (Playbook $39 / Builder Pack $99).

## Latest Issues

- [Issue 13: Stanford just measured the AI gap for young workers at 19%. Here's who's hiring around it.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-08-17/): Stanford's Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research's new Canaries Dashboard shows the AI-exposed employment gap for 22-25-year-olds has widened to 19%. Reddit's AI-native hiring push, Handshake's university-credentialed AI Fellowship, DoorDash's new gig-to-AI-training pipeline, and the entry-level title actually growing right now.
- [Issue 12: Four 2026 studies just measured the same AI divide. Here's what the winning 6–21% do differently.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-08-11/): PwC, ServiceNow, McKinsey, and NTT DATA independently surveyed nearly 20,000 executives this year and found the same split. What separates the winners, the domain-expert money still flowing on the training side, and one new role built to close the gap.
- [Issue 11: Hinton says 2026 brings the job losses. Here's the actual math behind that headline.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-08-03/): The METR capability curve actually behind Hinton's viral 2026 warning, what real payroll data already shows, the economist who reversed himself mid-year, and the specific 12-month plan for knowledge workers.
- [Issue 10: There are two doors into a frontier AI lab. Only one is open to you.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-07-27/): Real 2026 hiring data from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Perplexity — named hires, a program with a published 40%+ conversion rate, and the honest odds behind the "no traditional background" success stories.
- [Issue 9: LLMs. Agents. MCP. RAG. What do these terms actually mean?](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-07-20/): Plain-English breakdown of the 5 AI terms people keep hearing but nobody explains — LLM, Agent, MCP, RAG, and Context Window.
